# <span id="aanchor232"></span> Bulk Changes

Accessing this screen requires **System Information**, **Meter Edit**, and **List Edit** or **Location Edit** system process privileges.

Use the Bulk Changes tool to make changes (such as plate diameter or meter direction) to multiple meters, quality sources, or locations at the same time.

<div class="procedure">

To apply bulk changes:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **Bulk Changes**.

2.  Select a list, location or source list.

3.  Select a category. Options in the drop-down menu will vary based on the type of list you selected.

4.  Select a group. Options will vary based on the category you selected.

5.  Click **Edit** to enable the fields for editing.

6.  To change a field value, select **\<set to value\>** and specify the new value or select a value from the drop-down list, if available. To clear a field value, select **\<clear value\>**.

    If you select **\<set to value\>** and do not specify a value, no action is taken.

7.  Select the date range for which the changes will be applicable, if the fields are datetime effective. For fields that are not datetime effective, such as fields on the Meter Editor, the date range will be ignored.

8.  Select the reason for the change, if prompted, and click **Apply**.

    The progress of the changes will display. When all changes have been successfully applied, the status will change to "Complete".

</div>
